correctness.rationale: All coefficients independently follow from the exact degree-four cd-index, the universal gamma monomial evaluation in arXiv:2609.22078 Proposition 6.3, and Euler’s relation. Eight full facet-generated face lattices were exhaustively compared in integer arithmetic with all sixteen flag-h coefficients. Each of five deficits is rigorously nonnegative: vertices and facets >=5, vertex degrees >=4, edge links are polygons, two-faces are polygons. Equality in either gamma coefficient characterizes a simplex. Finite checks are corroboration; the proof is universal.
